purpose: Declare which observations may support a registered landscape performance metric, and what data remain insufficient. This map does not calculate metrics or certify impact.
principles: Observation ingestion never computes a landscape-performance metric by itself.
A supporting observation is not automatically an independent validation reference.
Missing, stale, uncalibrated, wrong-scale, or incompatible-unit inputs remain unknown/not-computable.
Modelled, observed, curated, synthetic and assumed inputs retain distinct evidence classes.
Only use an aggregation algorithm after its time/spatial coverage, unit conversions and missing-data policy are declared.
Do not combine the metric vector into a universal sustainability score.

unit_profile.rule: Use a declared unit vocabulary per property, preferably UCUM-compatible symbols. Do not convert units based only on matching labels.

required_non_observation_inputs: Georeferenced area of interest with area method
terrain/obstacle/canopy geometry
latitude/longitude and explicit local-time/timezone and date
pinned solar/shadow model
required_method_contracts: Declared shadow geometry method
Temporal matching window and missing-sample policy
Independent shade/temperature validation design
permitted_claims: Sensor values describe measured temperature/irradiance under their method and quality state.
prohibited_inferences: Surface temperature is not a direct measurement of shade fraction.
A few point sensors cannot establish area-wide shade coverage.
Synthetic or modeled values cannot be displayed as field observations.

required_non_observation_inputs: Delineated catchment geometry
Named event definition and boundary conditions
Sampling interval/gap policy
Flow-meter calibration or qualified rating curve when discharge is inferred
Pinned hydrology method/model and independent validation
required_method_contracts: Integrate discharge rate over event duration with explicit units
Account for irregular sampling and missing intervals
Keep event volume, peak discharge and modeled runoff separate
permitted_claims: Observed discharge and rainfall records within their quality/coverage envelope.
prohibited_inferences: A single discharge value is not event runoff volume.
Rainfall alone does not establish runoff.
An uncalibrated stage-to-flow conversion is not an accepted discharge observation.

required_non_observation_inputs: Crown polygon/segmented raster geometry with valid CRS and resolution
Area-of-interest polygon and overlap/edge rules
Imagery/source date and tree growth scenario if forecasting
required_method_contracts: A geometry-capable observation or raster feature contract
Classification accuracy assessment and class semantics
Area calculation method with uncertainty
permitted_claims: A categorized crown-related observation can support a future canopy workflow if its spatial payload and validation are supplied separately.
prohibited_inferences: One location or category record cannot compute area-based canopy fraction.
Rendered tree symbols are not tree-crown polygons.
Plant counts are not canopy cover.

required_non_observation_inputs: Planting schedule with intended denominator
Versioned taxonomy/vocabulary and provenance
Declared native/ecoregion suitability definition
Policy for unknown, conflicting and not-applicable identities
required_method_contracts: Bind identification to the exact design snapshot and feature ID where possible
Keep species identity separate from native/suitable/biodiversity-effect claims
permitted_claims: A source-backed species identification may satisfy one input-evidence requirement if the method and source are accepted.
prohibited_inferences: Taxonomic identity alone does not prove native status or ecological suitability.
Species evidence completeness does not prove biodiversity gain.
Unknown species cannot be omitted from the denominator without a declared policy.

required_non_observation_inputs: Authoritative path centerline and route continuity
Elevation profile with vertical datum and accuracy
Applicable accessibility jurisdiction/standard version
Surface and route conditions required by the standard
required_method_contracts: Declare segment boundaries/resolution and slope calculation
Check coverage along the full route before reporting a maximum
Separate engineering measurements from rendering geometry
permitted_claims: A validated local grade observation can describe one identified segment.
prohibited_inferences: One grade sample cannot establish maximum grade for the whole route.
Rendered path strokes are not authoritative centerlines.
A slope value alone does not establish accessibility-standard compliance.

required_non_observation_inputs: Bill of quantities with scope and unit reconciliation
Product/EPD or declared LCI source and version
Life-cycle modules, geography and reference year
Biogenic carbon and substitution assumptions
required_method_contracts: Pin quantity dataset and factor dataset independently
Declare factor units and lifecycle boundary before multiplication
Propagate range/uncertainty to total
permitted_claims: A sourced quantity or emission-factor record can support a declared inventory calculation.
prohibited_inferences: A quantity by itself is not embodied carbon.
Missing factor/EPD is not zero.
Incompatible EPD lifecycle modules cannot be summed without harmonization.

required_non_observation_inputs: Versioned maintenance obligations
Accepted role and authority basis
Cadence, trigger and resourcing commitments
Mycelix consent-aware stewardship record and access policy
required_method_contracts: Use the Mycelix stewardship profile for assignment/acceptance state
Record observed completion separately from the existence of a commitment
permitted_claims: Governance records can show a party accepted a defined maintenance obligation under a declared authority/consent context.
prohibited_inferences: A sensor observation cannot establish that a person accepted an obligation.
Assigned maintenance does not prove execution or plant survival.
Identity, reputation or a vote does not establish land title.

required_non_observation_inputs: Quantity takeoff
Declared currency/base year/geography and pricing date
Analysis horizon and discount/inflation conventions
Operating, replacement and end-of-life scenarios
required_method_contracts: Normalize currency and base-year only via declared conversion method
Provide low/base/high scenario ranges and sensitivity
Keep financial estimate separate from measured transaction/quotation evidence
permitted_claims: A sourced quote or historical cost observation can support a cost estimate within its date/geography scope.
prohibited_inferences: One quote is not a lifecycle cost range.
Unknown cost cannot become zero.
Costs cannot be added across currency/base years without a declared conversion.

global_acceptance_rules: Every mapping metric_id must match a metric in the versioned landscape metric registry before validation is enabled in a release.
Every observation used in a computation must match required units and evidence classes, have quality state/calibration semantics inspected, and be covered by an accepted method.
Observations linked to a design feature must pin the exact design snapshot digest; no feature ID is resolved against a different project snapshot.
No output metric is emitted when mandatory inputs are missing, stale, wrong-scale, uncalibrated where applicable, or conflicting.
Report model prediction, field observation, derived calculation and participant commitment in separate evidence classes.
Comparisons must pin baseline and proposal snapshots, the same forcing/boundary conditions and the computation version.
When the mapping or metric registry dependency has not been resolved to an exact schema/version, output remains not-computable.
